title: REVER Ride Log Weekly Ride Time Trend
dataSources: Garmin Zumo ride data (`garmin:zumo`), motorcycle OBD-II telemetry (`obd:bike`), RaceChrono laps (`racechrono:lap`), REVER rides (`rever:ride`), and RevZilla orders (`revzilla:order`).
app: Garmin Zumo ride exports, motorcycle OBD-II telemetry, RaceChrono track sessions, REVER ride logs, and RevZilla order history forwarded into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rever:ride ride_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(ride_minutes) as avg_duration, max(ride_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst ride time for REVER ride log events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture ride_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average ride time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It frames whether REVER ride log tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
